subject: general
question:
Six letters P, Q, R, S, T and U are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure below. Find the letter on the face opposite to R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04bc0de7fc1d1bf07ce465b62b459f697476a9b73836c7cb044eee71538aa381.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As R is common on both the dices, it is clear that P, T, Q, and U are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. S will be opposite to it.

= [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e3329b79f9428ab8884e08ca298f1268c78684552c56b468bd002c79c620520.png] 

Opposite pairs:

P → Q

T → U

R → S

So, the opposite side of "R" will be side "S".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
